changelog: v42b is a FIX REVISION of v42a: the v42a sensor rename could not take effect on units that had already run v42, because Home Assistant pins an entity_id in its entity registry the first time a unique_id is seen -- v42 registered this sensor as sensor.cytech_config_check, and changing the sensor name does NOT move a registered entity_id, so the System Health 'Config Check' row still showed 'Entity not found' (caught by a user screenshot on the bench unit). v42b changes the sensor's unique_id, which forces a fresh registration whose entity_id is derived from the current name: sensor.cytech_integrity_status, the id the dashboard already uses. Units coming from v41 or older never ran v42 and were never affected; they simply register the row correctly on first start. v42b also carries everything from v42a (self-heal + alerts) and the v42/v41/v40 recap below for units on older versions. v42 makes a corrupted configuration.yaml self-healing, and not just at boot: the system keeps a rolling known-good snapshot of configuration.yaml (refreshed after every clean check -- at boot and every 4 hours while running), and if the live file is ever found corrupt it is replaced by the snapshot with the broken copy saved as configuration.yaml.corrupt.<timestamp>, HA restarts (runtime corruption is repaired the same day it happens, before the next update's restart could land the system in HA recovery mode), and the integrity alert says so. Two safety properties: the snapshot is only refreshed after the configuration actually parsed clean, so a corrupted state can never be snapshotted as 'good'; and no restore happens unless the snapshot itself parses, so there is no restore loop. Integrity alerts are now also emailed (support@cytech.biz always, plus the owner's registered address per the v41 rule), and the System Health dashboard shows a Config Check row with the last running check result. For v39 or older, v42b also carries v40 and v41: the owner's address field is 'My Email for Alerts', a Register press always reports its status on screen (empty field: 'Enter your email first, then press Register.'), a successful Register sends ONE confirmation mail To: the owner Cc: support@cytech.biz, alerts ALWAYS go to support@cytech.biz with the owner's registered address copied automatically (no Cytech/Me/Both selector), and units with mail configured but no owner registered yet show a small non-blocking hint. Nothing is lost if the owner never registers: support@cytech.biz always receives every alert.
